# Docs commands a plugin may run

306 of the 633 Docs registry commands are on the allowlist (docs/plugins.md section 8). `read` ids need `document = "read"`, every other id `document = "write"`. `params` is the registry's own description of the parameters; a `run` whose params hold a key named `path`, `dir`, `file`, `url`, `uri`, `href` or `src` is refused.

(%n = level n's number; the bullet character for bullet), "start"?: n, "restartAfter"?: 0-8 (0 = never; omit = the level above), "style"?: paragraph style linked to the level \| null, "align"?: "left\|center\|right", "alignedAt"?: pt, "indentAt"?: pt, "follow"?: "tab\|space\|nothing", "tabAt"?: pt \| null, "font"?: string \| null, "bold"?: bool, "italic"?: bool, "color"?: "RRGGBB" \| null, "legal"?: bool}, …] (index = level, up to 9; fields left out keep the base list's), "num"?: list id to change in place (default: a new list), "apply"?: bool (default true: number the selected paragraphs), "name"?: string}` |

| `table.fitColumn` | write | AutoFit Column by Double-Clicking | `{"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt, "reach"?: pt} (a double-click on a column border: the column left of it fits its contents and the columns right of it keep their widths, moving with the border, so the table narrows or widens (up to the right margin), as in Word)` |

| `table.insertAt` | write | Insert Row or Column by Clicking | `{"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt, "reach"?: pt} (a click on a table's insert button: left of a row border adds a row there, above a column border a column; the new row or column is selected, as in Word)` |

| `table.properties` | write | Properties | `{"align"?: "left\|center\|right", "rtl"?: bool, "width"?: pt\|null, "widthPct"?: percent, "indent"?: pt, "rowHeight"?: pt\|null, "rowHeightRule"?: "atLeast\|exact", "allowBreak"?: bool, "headerRow"?: bool, "columnWidth"?: pt, "cellWidth"?: pt\|null, "valign"?: "top\|center\|bottom"} (row, column and cell settings apply to the caret's; without settings it returns the current ones)` |
| `table.quick` | write | Quick Tables | `{"kind"?: "calendar\|tabular\|matrix"}` |
| `table.repeatHeader` | write | Repeat Header Rows | `{}` |

| `table.rowHeight` | write | Table Row Height | `{"height": pt, "rule"?: "atLeast\|exact"} (every row the selection covers, the caret's without one)` |
| `table.rtl` | write | Right-to-Left Table | `{"value"?: bool} (true: the first column stands at the right; without a value it toggles)` |
| `table.selectAt` | write | Select Table Cells by Clicking | `{"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt, "toX"?: pt, "toY"?: pt, "reach"?: pt} (a click in page points, 0-based page, on a selection area of a table in the caret's story: just above a column selects the column, left of a row the row, along a cell's left edge inside it the cell, the move handle past the top-left corner the table; with toX/toY (a drag) every column, row or cell from there to that point. `reach` (default 3) is the column borders' resize reach, which the cell areas keep clear of.)` |

| `table.split` | write | Split Cells | `{"columns"?: n (2), "rows"?: n (1), "mergeFirst"?: bool (true: several selected cells are merged first)}` |
| `table.splitTable` | write | Split Table | `{}` |
